THE CALLER IS REPORTING THAT SEVERAL COMPLAINTS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BY PRIVATE CITIZENS TO THE LOCAL POLICE DEPARTMENT OF A STRONG ODOR IN THE ATMOSPHERE. THE ODOR CAN BE SMELT AS FAR AS A .5 MILE AWAY FROM THE SITE. WHEN ALL EMERGENCY RESPONDERS ARRIVED ONSCENE A LARGE CAPACITY 44 FT. X 10 FT. DIAMETER STORAGE TANK (AT 55%) WAS DISCOVERED LEAKING. THE CALLER STATED THAT THE RP AND FIRE DEPARTMENT SIMPLY TOOK A WATER HOSE AND IS SPRAYING WATER ON THE TANK STATING "IT LOOKS GOOD TO THEM". THE CALLER STATED THAT THE THE AMMONIA IS RELEASING APPROXIMATELY 1 GALLON EVERY 3 HOURS TO THE AIR AND SOIL (POOLING AROUND THE TANK). THE CALLER STATED THAT HE IS CONCERNED FOR THE RESIDENCE BECAUSE THERE IS A POSSIBILITY FOR GROUND WATER (DRINKING WATER) TO BE CONTAMINATED. HE ALSO STATED THAT THIS HAS OCCURRED BEFORE AT THE LOCATION APPROXIMATELY 1 MONTH AGO.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.043345, -84.700001 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 350 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THERE WAS A ETHYLENE GLYCOL LEAK IN THE COOLING SYSTEM ON THE ROOF OF THE FACILITY. THE MATERIAL DRAINED INTO THE ON-SITE DETENTION POND WHERE IT WAS CAPTURED. UPON INSPECTION OF THE DETENTION POND IT WAS DETERMINED THAT A SMALL AMOUNT MAY HAVE DISCHARGED THROUGH THE OVERFLOW WITH STORM WATER. THE PREDOMINANT AMOUNT OF THE MATERIAL WAS CAPTURED IN THE DETNETION POND. THE FACILITY IMMEDIATELY CALLED AN ENVIRNMENTAL CLEAN UP COMPANY TO COME AND PUMP THE MATERIAL FROM THE POND. THEY CAME OUT AND COMPLETED AN INITIAL PUMP OUT. THE FACILITY HAS HAD THE COMPANY COME OUT TO INSPECT AND REMOVE THE REST OF THE MATERIAL FROM THE LOW SPOTS IN THE DETENTION POND.

ON 08/19/2012 AT 1811 HOURS, YARDMASTER, REPORTED TANK CAR UTLX671315 (LOAD- XYLENES) THAT ARRIVED INTO THE YARD ON TRAIN Q51419 HAD AN UNKNOWN SUBSTANCE LEAKING FROM THE PIPES ON THE BOTTOM OF THE TANK CAR AT MP S 362.2 ON THE COLUMBIA SUBDIVISION. THIS IS LOCATED IN THE CAYCE YARD AT 500 TAYLOR STREET IN CAYCE, SOUTH CAROLINA. THE LEAK STARTED AS A STEADY STREAM AND THEN SLOWED, AND NOTED IT WAS POSSIBLE THE SUBSTANCE WAS CONDENSATION. HAZMAT WAS CONFERENCE CALLED IN AND WILL HAVE A CONTRACTOR EN ROUTE TO INSPECT THE TANK CAR. CAYCE POLICE AND FIRE WAS NOTIFIED AND PERSONNEL RESPONDED. UPDATE: AT 1925 HOURS APPROXIMATELY ONE GALLON OF XYLENES LEAKED ONTO THE GROUND.

THE FIRE DEPARTMENT SUGGESTED TO TURN OFF OF THE WATER.

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.220039, -89.519539 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 2 gallon
Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING AN UPDATE TO #1048269. THE UPDATED INFORMATION CONSISTS OF WATERWAY IMPACT. THE UNION PACIFIC TRAIN HAD 11 CARS DERAIL. 9 CARS WERE LOADED AUTO RACKS AND THE OTHER 2 BOX CARS WITH UNKNOWN CONTENTS. THE DERAILED CAR(S) FROM BNSF ARE UNKNOWN. ORIGINAL REPORT STATES: A UNION PACIFIC TRAIN AND A BNSF TRAIN COLLIDED. THE CAUSE IS UNKNOWN. TWO CONFIRMED UNION PACIFIC CREW INJURIES. THE COLLISION ALSO DAMAGED A HIGHWAY BRIDGE. ONE CONFIRMED VEHICLE OCCUPANT INJURY (BROKEN ANKLE). NO REPORTED FATALITIES AT THIS TIME. TWO TRACKS INTERSECT DIRECTLY BELOW THE BRIDGE. THE BNSF TRAIN WAS TRAVELING THE N/S TRACK, AND THE UNION PACIFIC TRAIN WAS TRAVELING THE E/W TRACK. THE COLLISION RESULTED IN DERAILMENT OF AN UNKNOWN NUMBER OF RAIL UNITS, WHICH IS WHAT CAUSED THE DAMAGE TO THE BRIDGE.
